newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hajdutej to seek delisting its shares.
newsitem.headline: Hajdutej to seek delisting its shares.

text.p: Hungarian dairy firm Hajdutej Rt will ask its shareholders for approval to delist the company's stocks from the Budapest Stock Exchange, Hajdutej said on Wednesday.
Hajdutej, the Hungarian dairy unit of Nutricia of the Netherlands, will hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on March 25 with discussion of the delisting on the agenda.
Nutricia holds a 96.7 percent stake in Hajdutej.
A Hajdutej board of directors member told Reuters in January that if Nutricia kept control of Hajdutej, it was likely to delist the share from the BSE.

Nutricia and Friesland NV, also of the Netherlands, announced in early February that they had called off talks aimed at combining or swapping some of their activities in a number of countries, including Hungary.
